annotations.title: List who holds which app role

description: List the role grants of an app's project, as { grants }: who holds which role and until when. Pass userId to see one person's. Roles that come from the employees board (set_policy_identity) are not grants and are not listed here; explain_access with a userId shows the roles a person ends up with. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

userId.description: Only this user's grants (userId from list_app_users)

name: list_app_role_grants
